summary: This class announced a partial exam on 2025-11-27 that is not shown on the course page and covers all concepts from the presentations up to then. The teacher also said Task 2 was due 2025-11-26 but opened it only during this class, whereas the course page lists it as having opened on 2025-11-10. She noted the previous week's class had been cancelled and that class would resume the following week, and she demonstrated/recommended the UCSC Genome Browser exercises. No grading, group, attendance, or room details were mentioned.

items.title: Previous class cancelled
items.details: The teacher apologized for not coming to class last week due to a family/unforeseen problem and said it had been more than two weeks without class.

items.title: UCSC Genome Browser exercises
items.details: Teacher demonstrated the UCSC Genome Browser and recommended that students complete the exercises on exploring the human genome, sequence conservation, and variation.

items.title: Partial exam (Block 1)
items.details: Teacher said she thinks there is a partial exam on November 27, 2025, covering all concepts from the presentations so far; she hoped to finish with block number one.

items.title: Task 2 deadline and opening
items.details: Teacher said Task 2 could be delivered until November 26, 2025 and should be started early. A student could not see it, so the teacher opened it during class; the course page lists an earlier opening date.

items.title: Next class
items.details: Teacher said next week there would be class again; no room change was mentioned.
